summary: Community event card: gradient cover with date and mode, title, location and time, seat bar, attendees, and an action.
whenToUse: Lists and grids of community events, meetups, webinars, and workshops.
Highlighting seat availability (last seats, sold out) directly in the card.
whenNotToUse: Events in a dense agenda or calendar: use a compact list or table.
Editorial content without a date: use ArticleCard.

props.name: title
props.description: Event title; with `href` it becomes the card's link.

props.name: href
props.description: Event page: the whole card becomes clickable (stretched link) while tags and actions stay clickable.

props.name: date
props.description: Event day, shown with DateBadge on the cover.

props.name: tone
props.description: Cover gradient (brand token or data palette).

props.name: mode
props.description: Attendance mode, shown as a “glass” label on the cover.

props.name: watermark
props.description: Large, transparent decorative text on the cover (hidden from assistive technologies).

props.name: tags
props.description: Tags or badges above the title.

props.name: capacity
props.description: Total seats: when set, shows the capacity bar.

props.name: lowSeatsThreshold
props.description: Remaining-seats threshold below which the “Last seats” warning appears.

props.name: attendeesLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the attendee group.

props.name: isLoading
props.description: Renders a SkeletonCard in its place with a cover and action of the same shape (aria-busy, hidden non-live “Loading…” text), keeping className and style so it stays in the grid. Wrap the area in SkeletonGroup for a single announcement.

inherits: HTML attributes of <article> (except `title`); ref forwarded to the article element.

keyboard.action: Reaches the title link (if `href`), then interactive tags and actions.
On the title, opens the event page.

accessibility: The stretched link is a single link on the title: no nested links, and actions remain separately focusable.
The date has full text for screen readers; the watermark and the mode dot are decorative.
The seat bar is a meter with a text value (“86 / 120 posti”) and a status (last seats / sold out) that is also visible as text.
responsive: Adapts to the container width; meta and footer wrap. Ideal in a Grid with minItemWidth ~18rem.
customization: `className` on the root; stable classes are `dc-event-card-*`.
The `brand` tone uses `--dc-gradient-accent`; the other tones use the `--dc-color-data-*` tokens.
In forced-colors mode, the cover becomes Canvas with a border.
commonMistakes: Putting a Link or Button inside `title` when using `href`: it creates nested controls.
Passing `seatsTaken` without `capacity`: the bar is not shown.
